name: MetroConnect
description: A local-first Delhi NCR transit companion for route planning, official-style fares, interactive maps, live journey tracking, and detailed station information across DMRC, NMRC, Rapid Metro, Airport Express, and Namo Bharat.

bullets.text: Plans journeys across DMRC, NMRC, Rapid Metro, Airport Express, and Namo Bharat with fastest, fewest-stations, and minimum-interchange route preferences.
Calculates official-style fares for DMRC weekdays and holidays, Rapid Metro, Airport Express, NMRC Aqua Line, and Namo Bharat.
Renders an interactive Skia metro map with pan, zoom, line visibility controls, station labels, user location, and active-route highlighting.
Tracks live journeys through GPS polling with remaining time and stations, route progress, and interchange or destination push notifications.
Provides fuzzy station search, nearest-station detection, and detailed facilities, platforms, gates, parking, images, and Google Maps links.
Persists recent searches, quick stations, routes, and map settings locally, with light, dark, and system themes plus Remote Config update prompts.
